skills.name: ENJOY THE FUN
skills.description: Whenever an ally performs a PERFECT Receive or PERFECT Save, YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival) gains {1}% Power ATK and Save stats, up to {2}%.\nWhenever an ally touches the ball, YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival) gains {3} stack(s) of the [Fun] buff, each stack increasing his Power ATK by {4}%, up to {5} stacks.

skills.name: ATHLETIC RECEIVE
skills.description: YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival) performs a Save with with power equal to {1}% of his Save stat. The power of his next spike increases by {2}% of his Power ATK stat.

skills.name: PASSION IGNITED
skills.description: After YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival) performs INSTANT JUDGMENT SPIKE, your side’s next Save is guaranteed to be PERFECT.\nWhen your side performs a PERFECT Save, YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival)'s Awareness increases by {1}% for his next spike. At the end of the round, all [Fun] stacks are removed and for every {2} stack(s) removed this way, the power of YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival)'s touches increases by {3}% of the corresponding stat, up to {4}% and lasting for {5} turn(s)

skills.name: INSTANT JUDGMENT SPIKE
skills.description: YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival) performs a Rebound with power equal to {1}% of his Power ATK stat. The opponent’s Block power is reduced by {2}% of their Block stat, and the Block result is guaranteed to be PERFECT.

YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival)'s Awareness increases by {0}%. Each time your side performs a PERFECT touch, YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival)'s Power ATK increases by {1}%, up to {2}%, lasting until his next spike.

When your side performs a PERFECT Set, YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival)'s Strength increases by {0}% for {1} net crossing(s). While YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival) is on the court, if your side performs a PERFECT Save, your side's next touch is guaranteed to be PERFECT.

bonds.name: Fireworks Festival
bonds.description: MORISUKE YAKU (Fireworks Festival)'s Save increases by {0} points. YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival) gains a Receive Skill: YUJI TERUSHIMA (Fireworks Festival) performs a Receive with {1}% of Receive stat power (Cooldown: {2} net crossings)
